title: Ritual Dagger of Shar
summary: A +1 dagger that adds 1d4 Necrotic to melee hits.

fields.Weapon profile: 1d4 + 1 Piercing plus applicable ability modifier, +1 to attack rolls, plus 1d4 Necrotic on melee hits. Simple, one-handed, 5 ft, Finesse, Light, Thrown and Dippable. The bonus Necrotic is omitted on a throw.
fields.Piercing Strike: With proficiency, Action once per Short Rest. Melee weapon damage on hit. Constitution save against weapon-action DC +2 prevents Gaping Wounds for 2 turns. Undead and Constructs are immune. Healing clears it. Standard mode hits add 2 Piercing. Honour Mode adds 2 of the original damage type to any damage source.
fields.Acquisition: Hidden altar in the Sharran Sanctuary, X 249, Y −847. Picking it up can inspire A Dark Edge and Ruthless Craftsmanship. Shadowheart disapproves by 1 unless she takes it herself. Taking or moving the dagger starts combat with three sentinels.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
